content.thinking:
`rng.sample(range(1<<64), n)` overflows. Let me generate keys differently: `sorted({rng.getrandbits(4*width) for _ in range(n)})`.

Also the fronts must be sorted (I do sort) ✓.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
p='/workspace/tmp/dev/t12.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("        keys = sorted(rng.sample(range(1 << (4 * width)), min(n, 1 << (4 * width))))",
            "        keys = sorted({rng.getrandbits(4 * width) for _ in range(n)})")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
